title: Rejoinder: Spilling More Beans on Political Consumerism: It’s More of the Same Tune
authors: Jūra Liaukonytė; Anna E. Tuchman; Xinrong Zhu
eligible_reason: Not a panel DiD. The only regressions (aggregate_graph.do, Figure 2) use a single national weekly Spotify subscriber index: a linear pre-trend fit, then reghdfe of the detrended index on event-week dummies post_1-post_8 for one common event (week 162, the Spotify-Rogan controversy) with week-of-year FE. One time series, one event date; no cross-sectional units and no staggered adoption.
design_notes: Stata. Rejoinder; two do-files produce Figures 1 and 2 only (Twitter mention counts for Goya/Spotify around their boycott dates; Spotify weekly subscriber index 2019-2022, 180 weeks). Paths point to the authors' server.

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: single aggregate time series, single event date, detrended with pre-period linear trend
descriptive plots of Twitter mention counts

data_files_note: spotify_sales_2.dta: 180 weekly rows (week, sales, index). spotify_goya_twitter.dta: daily mention counts.
data_provenance_note: Aggregated series as used in the figures.
screener_notes: Screened from package and OpenAlex metadata (no article text). Rejoinder to comments on the Goya boycott paper; no staggered design.
